messages:
morgan: Retro/analog game night at my building rec room this Friday — projector + 'old TV' vibes? Anyone up for consoles + some PC LAN?

trey: In! Bringing Switch + Smash + extra Pro controller. :smash:

sunita: I'll bring my 27" monitor and an 8-port unmanaged switch. Also a power strip.

kelly: Can I stream clips? Anyone have a capture card I can borrow? :camera: 

morgan: Sweet. Need adapters for CRT? If you have N64 pads + USB adapters that'd be awesome.

trey: I have 2 USB N64 adapters.

sunita: Planning to do a small AoE2 LAN too. If someone's on Linux, you might need to open port 2300 — quick command:
```
sudo ufw allow 2300/tcp
```

trey: Good call. Also, anyone got spare ethernet cables (cat6)? I packed light.

sunita: I have a couple 10ft cat6s.

kelly: I'll handle food. Pizza ok? Any allergies/diets?

morgan: Veg and GF options please. Thanks!

trey: Also created a tiny emoji poll — react with one of these for what you want queued first:
:smash: Smash
:kart: Mario Kart
:aoe2: Age of Empires 2
:overcooked: Couch co-op

kelly: :smash:

sunita: :aoe2:

morgan: :kart:

games-bot: Poll results so far — Smash 1, Mario Kart 1, AoE2 1

morgan: Plan: arrive 6pm, do warm-up casuals, switch to PC lane around 8:30. Parking: street only, limited — suggest carpool.

trey: I can bring an extra surge protector and an HDMI switcher.

kelly: Bringing a pair of Joy-Cons and a USB capture if needed.

morgan: Awesome. Final reminder — bring ID for building desk, and label your gear. See you Friday :party_parrot:
